1 EXT. SECLUDED HOUSE - NIGHT al
LEGEND: McMINN COUNTY, TENNESSEE. RAIN POUNDS the small
clapboard house. The dim light of a table lamp leaks through a
single bedroom window. Dark woods sway violently in the HOWLING
WIND. As LIGHTNING CRACKS and THUNDER RUMBLES:

CUr: TO:

2 INT. BEDROOM - NIGHT —- A RATTLESNAKE RATTLE 2
Sits atop a dresser -- it's a dried-out curio that we may or may
not recognize for what it is. It lies like a paperweight atop
a sheet of PRINTOUT. Though we can't read the particulars, we
see the header "MEDICAL TEST RESULTS." PULL BACK OFF this as...
...A hand comes into frame, grabs up the printout. The rattle
slides off, RATTLING as it lands on the dresser. We ADJUST TO
the face of a YOUNG MAN, early 20s, lean and angular. He scans
the printout -- not surprised, and definitely not happy. He
quickly tears it in half, balls up the pieces.

LOW ANGLE - ACROSS A WASTE BASKET
The Man drops the crumpled sheet into the trash. He turns his (X)
back on us, hurriedly yanks open the dresser's drawers. He
grabs handfuls of clothes and jams them in an old suitcase on
the bed. More LIGHTNING and THUNDER.
CLOSER —- THE MAN :
Packs at a frantic pace. Something-Is got him seriously spooked.
His lips start to move. We don't realize he's actually saying
anything at first. But as he continues to pack, his voice rises
to a fast, fearful, barely audible WHISPER.
MAN

Holy Ghost, come to me. Praise

God -- praise God. Move up on

me, Holy Ghost...
CLOSE - A NIGHT STAND
Gets yanked open -- an old BIBLE lies inside. The man's hands
grab it up, grip it tight. Just inside rests a photo of a YOUNG
WOMAN, smiling and shielding her eyes from the sun.

MAN

Praise God, this here sinner

repents. Move up on me, Holy

Ghost -- protect me and mine

with your quick'ning power.
